scope: JobPosting fields with absent or unsupported values; not a broad SEO audit.
policy: Omit empty strings, nulls, empty containers and explicit unknown placeholders recursively. Preserve meaningful false/zero values when they are otherwise valid.
Do not substitute job titles or requirements for missing descriptions; keep the full supplied description.
Employment type requires a supported value plus employer entry or matching source wording/labels; unknown types do not become OTHER.
Only set directApply=true for employer-posted applications handled by this site; unknown external journeys omit the field.
Dates explicitly marked first_seen are not employer publication dates. Missing dates and deadlines are omitted.
Only publish a physical jobLocation from a structured source address with a recognized country; generic location labels are not city addresses.
Do not mark explicitly hybrid labels as TELECOMMUTE.
Salary requires known units, positive consistent bounds and documented currency; missing bounds remain absent.
Use only safe HTTP(S) website/logo URLs.

verification.audit_page: Same report repeated on production and controlled local Django fixtures; all output fields reviewed, no truncated evidence.

audit_outcomes.title: Production page issues
audit_outcomes.reason: No issues, recommendations or warnings returned by the bounded page audit; it does not validate Google-required JobPosting facts.

audit_outcomes.title: Canonical differs from final URL
audit_outcomes.reason: Local fixture intentionally retains the production canonical URL. The live page is self-canonical.

verification.local_warning: Non-HTTP links excluded from page link evidence; unrelated to JSON-LD validity.

limitations: Valid JSON and omission of unknown fields do not establish Google Jobs rich-result eligibility.
Google requires source-backed location data for job enhancement. Omitting missing required facts cannot eliminate those eligibility errors.

All 3435 current records retained title, description, employer and date fields. Existing unflagged imported publication dates are preserved; this change does not independently verify each original employer date.
Google Rich Results Test, indexing and search appearance were not independently verified.
